text:
Rowan: Pushed a 'starlight' dark theme pass in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/starlight-pass. Aim: neutral-black base (#030303), soft card lift (#0C0D0E), and a compact accent ramp that still reads at 10px. Please quick-check legends, micro-badges, code blocks, and chart thumbnails.
Keiko: Quick scan: legend swatches at 12px are ambiguous when there are 7 items. Can we either increase swatch to 14px or add hover-to-highlight? Hover-to-highlight seems better for dense lists.
Hector: Agree on hover. Also tiny badge counters (8px) are failing contrast in dark panels. Either bump min size to 10px or add a 1px inner backdrop.
Mina: For inline code in threads: pale teal as background is lost on low-dpi. Suggest switch to a left accent bar instead of filled token. CSS idea: `.inline-code{border-left:2px solid var(--accent);padding-left:6px;background:transparent}`
Sam: Charts: stacked bars look muddy for adjacent colors. Recommend perceptual lightness ramp (Lab L* deltas) not just hue shifts. Helps colorblind folks too.
Rowan: Good notes. I'll create a Lab-based ramp and paste swatches. For badges I'll prototype 10px min + subtle backdrop.
Keiko: Microcopy: tooltips still say "units" in some places. Standardize to "tokens" across the Console.
Mina: Also add `aria-label` to chart toggles, e.g., `aria-label="Chart: hourly token usage"` so screen readers announce context.
Hector: One more: JSON code block keys use orange now which collides with error red. Propose keys = #BFAEFF (muted lavender), strings = #9BD8A0, numbers = #7FC9FF so errors remain distinct.
Sam: For tiny sparklines (6-10px) add a faint outer stroke using panel-contrast color so lines don't disappear on 1x displays. Maybe stroke-opacity 0.92 + 0.5px outline.
Rowan: I'll try the outline-on-sparklines and the key color swap. If folks can drop :thumbsup: in figma comments I'll cut a theme-token PR today.
Design-Bot: Design review created: DR-4477 - "Starlight: legend sizes, sparklines, and code token legibility" assigned to @Rowan. Comments due in 48h.
Keiko: Leaving short comments in Figma on legend spacing and the badge examples.
Mina: I'll run a quick Axe contrast pass after the updated tokens land.
Rowan: Thanks all 44D will post the token PR + tiny changelog later today.
